messages:
violet (CS): Quick sync: Versa dedicated pool go-live set for Mon 08:45 PT. Goals: agree quota windows, autoscale headroom for their multimodal migration at +80m, and a 10m smoke test. Who can own each piece?

oscar (SRE): I can own watch. Proposed ramp: 6m KV/embeddings priming -> 8m @20% -> 12m @55% -> 20m soak at target. Autoscale: scale-up on cpu_95>0.9 OR queue_ms>1600 for 2m; scale-down after 10m stable below 60%. Rollback triggers: sustained >4% errors for 10m OR p95>3s for 12m.

hana (Infra): Add a small prefix-heavy cache prime (5m) and pre-warm multimodal encoders. We'll pin the model to versa-multi-v1.0-quant for the first 24h to limit behavior drift. Also suggest limiting concurrent long-context/ocr jobs to 6 for the first 2h.

matt (Solutions): Versa expects a bursty multimodal import (+80m). Request: temporary headroom 2.2x for 6m when we detect the import signal. Also they want a dedicated embeddings quota for the first 60m and a per-route latency dashboard link for ops.

violet (CS): @hana can you confirm model pin + concurrency cap? @oscar please add the headroom rule to the autoscale policy and paste the exact JSON to CS-9122. I'll ask Versa to hold heavy imports until we give go.

hana (Infra): Confirmed: model pinned to versa-multi-v1.0-quant for 24h; fallback warmed versa-multi-v0.9-fp16 in control plane. Concurrency cap enforced via proxy. Note added to CS-9122.

oscar (SRE): Pasting autoscale snippet to CS-9122 (short):

```
{"scale_up":"cpu_95>0.9 or queue_ms>1600","cooldown_up":"2m","scale_down":"cpu_5<0.6","cooldown_down":"10m","burst_headroom":{"factor":2.2,"duration":"6m","trigger":"import_at_+80m"},"embeddings_temp_quota":"140rps","limits":{"min":8,"max":260}}
```

matt (Solutions): I'll set embeddings soft quota=140 rps for first 60m and share dashboard link: https://console.redwood.dev/dash/versa-latency . Also will coordinate the +80m import notice; they will notify 15m prior.

evg (eng-bot): Ticket CS-9122 created: Versa dedicated bring-up orchestration. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-9122

violet (CS): Who will run the 10m smoke at 09:15 PT? Plan: mixed multimodal + embeddings + a few long-context OCR jobs to exercise quotas.

matt (Solutions): I'll run smoke with Versa SRE. Suggested local script for smoke (mix):

```
for i in {1..60}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -d '{"route":"chat","prompt":"ok"}' & curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"ping"}' & sleep 0.4; done
```

hana (Infra): I'll start cache priming at 08:30 PT and ensure the fallback toggle is ready. Post-run please attach p95/p99 latency export and a preliminary cost delta estimate for the first 24h so we can flag any renewal risk.

oscar (SRE): Adding an alert to oncall for rollback thresholds. Rollback authority: SRE (oscar) + infra lead (hana) to flip fallback.

violet (CS): Final EOD checklist: 1) oscar paste autoscale & alerts to CS-9122, 2) hana add model pin + fallback link and run priming job, 3) matt schedule smoke and share dashboard + confirm customer hold, 4) I'll prepare renewal risk blurb and customer-facing runbook. Aim to close prep by EOD today. :white_check_mark: 

matt (Solutions): Versa confirmed hold and will notify 15m before the import. All set.
